caveat: Verification and exploration, not a ranking. Differences are paired by seed within each experiment and never across experiments. After the first loss the arms' engagement draws diverge, so pairing only removes the pre-loss noise. With this many comparisons some 95% intervals exclude zero by chance. clear_steps uses ground-truth Red; absorb is an experimental logical reassignment; handoff delays are unsourced and 0 is an idealized baseline.
